summary: dedent removes indentation shared by every nonblank line.
documentation: dedent removes indentation shared by every nonblank line. Relative indentation remains, and whitespace-only lines are normalized. This lets an indented multiline template be displayed without its source-code margin.
inputs: A multiline string using spaces for indentation.
returns: Text with the common leading indentation removed.
caution: Tabs and spaces are both whitespace but are not interchangeable when finding the common prefix. This exercise uses spaces only and does not trim leading or trailing newlines.
scenarios: Prepare an indented email template for a plain-text preview.
Clean a multiline help message embedded in source code.
Remove a shared margin from a pasted code example while keeping nested indentation.
title: Remove a shared text margin
problem: Return textwrap.dedent(input). Keep relative indentation and final newlines. Inputs use spaces rather than tabs. Blank whitespace-only lines become empty lines.
hint: Import dedent; strip would remove meaningful boundary whitespace.
goal: Use textwrap.dedent() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
